question: My friend accidentally returned a rental DVD box with melon bread inside. What should I do?
answer: Yeeeaaahhh.... IT HAPPENS--. Yep, those things occur a lot! OF COURSE NOT! (shock) ...but think carefully. Was your friend really renting a DVD? Has it occurred to you that he was actually renting the melon bread? Ya know then, him returning the melon bread would be correct. Heh heh heh heh heh. MY ASS!!! (shock) WHAT THE HECK IS A RENTAL MELON BREAD!! (vein pops)
name: Ponkaichidou
